name: Open-SWE-Traces
summary: NVIDIA dataset of software-engineering agent trajectories (OpenHands, SWE-agent, mini-swe-agent, Claude Code, OpenCode) for distilling SWE agents; CC BY 4.0.
description: Full message histories, tool definitions, model and gold patches and success metadata for issue-resolution tasks drawn from permissively licensed task sets (Scale-SWE, SWE-rebench-V2). Versioned configs: v1.0 (151k cleaned trajectories from MiniMax and Qwen models; git-hacking runs removed), v1.1 (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Qwen3.6-27B), v1.2 (Qwen3.8-27B) and v2.0, released 2026-10-26 (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, xhigh reasoning) with splits per harness. Size category 100K–1M rows; parquet. The card states it is ready for commercial and non-commercial use.

agent_access.notes: Not gated; load with `datasets.load_dataset("nvidia/Open-SWE-Traces", "v2.0")` or download the parquet files.
